country_decisions: CFG-GOV-002: constitutional structure and institution registry (each institution and its relationships, recorded through the institution register; none ship).
CFG-GOV-011: approved data exchange and interoperability standards (exchange relationships, purposes and contracts; none ship).
CFG-DAT-001: retention and disclosure of the case and its records.

library.title: Propose handing over a service to another institution
library.intro: Propose that another institution takes over responsibility for a service, with the records, open cases and obligations transferred. It accepts by two officials; who is responsible changes only through its own change process.
library.filled_by: An official of the institution handing over.
library.authority: Each institution's own: worked by the institution that receives the request, under its own adopted procedure (xi.<template>.<institution>); never a central administrator's.

deviations.what: The owner is each institution itself: it adopts the cross-institution templates as its own procedures (xi.<template>.<institution>), drafted by one of its officials and approved by another; the case belongs to the institution that receives the request
deviations.why: Every institution decides what is asked of it under its own powers; no central administrator works another institution's cases.

deviations.what: What one institution asks of another is a case of the receiving institution's own procedure; its nature is recorded when it is taken in: an instruction only where an approved instruct relationship from the requester covers it, otherwise a request it may decline with reasons
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 13 §2.2: cross-institution tasks must not silently become binding orders; specification Part 5 E: federation must not transfer authority by accident.

deviations.what: Recording an agreement, accepting a handover or approving access grants no power: an exchange needs an approved exchange relationship, a read an audit or request-information relationship, a change of who is responsible its own change process
deviations.why: Specification Part 5 E: federation must not silently grant access or transfer authority; relationships are the nation's law, recorded through policy-change.ts.

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
